text_block_list.text:
In the cafeteria around lunchtime. Just as 
I picked up the Daily Special A I ordered 
and went to find a seat—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'd like to order. Can I get 
the limited-time—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
One "Divine Spicy Heaven Ascension MAX 
Curry," please!
(Murmur...!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you in your right mind...? This dish 
is so spicy that anyone who eats it is 
said to leap high enough to bust through 
the Pearly Gates, you know...?

It turns out the dish Satono Crown ordered 
is unusually spicy. I'm honestly starting 
to get worried.
choice_data_list:
That looks super spicy, are you sure 
you're okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Nǐ hǎo, Trainer! I appreciate your 
concern, but there's no need to worry, 
alright?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to spicy food, and I love it. In 
fact, I'm looking forward to seeing just 
how hot it is♪

text_block_list.name: Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Party of three waiting for the "Divine 
Spicy Heaven Ascension MAX Curry"~~!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Sí! That's an order from El, yeees!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeeek...! I'll be right thereee~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you senpais are having Heaven Curry 
too! Would you like to eat together if 
you'd like?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Lunch tastes way better when it's 
lively-desu!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is it really okay for me to join 
too~? Well then, pardon me~.

The three of them looked completely 
unfazed before a curry that was visibly 
blazing hot. Still worried, I decided to 
join them at the table.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Super spicy! Super tasty! Absolutely 
thrilled! This is the kick El has been 
searching for, yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Nom nom, chomp chomp... Phew~ it's so 
delishioush~

The two continued eating, unfazed by the 
heat. As for Satono Crown, however—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Hou hou sik aa!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This is it, this is what I'm talking 
about! This burning feeling deep in my 
core! I can't get enough of it!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! If you're curious, 
Trainer, do you want a taste too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Really? But it's so delicious! Well then, 
I'm eating it all myself!!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal! Thank you for the 
meal! Thank you for the meal~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Completely satisfied! It truly tasted 
heavenly, didn't it?
choice_data_list: Now that was some impressive eating!

Now that was some impressive eating, 
wasn't it!

All three of you have incredible spice 
tolerance…

All three of you have incredible spice 
tolerance, huh…

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Completely satisfied! It truly tasted 
heavenly, didn't it?
choice_data_list: Now that was some impressive eating!

Now that was some impressive eating, 
wasn't it!

All three of you have incredible spice 
tolerance…

All three of you have incredible spice 
tolerance, huh…

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Great flavor, and no complaints 
about the spice either! It was a curry 
that was perfect for me♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Looks like our tastes in spice match 
up, *desu*! I'll treat you to El's special 
Salsa Vida-soaked burrito next time, 
*deesu*!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, me too...! I know the secret 
menu trick to make regular cafeteria 
dishes extra spicy, so...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Whoa♪ Thank you so much! Let's have lunch 
together again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You love super spicy food too, Miss 
Crown?! To think you can go toe-to-toe 
with El-senpai and Doto-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
To finish that completely and reach 
heaven... Impressive, Crown-san...!

From that day on, Satono Crown and the 
others came to be known by some students 
as the "Tracen Academy Spicy Alliance."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Less of a tolerance and more of a 
familiarity, perhaps? It's a taste I've 
been used to since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-It also... stung a bit at first, but 
once I got used to it, that stimulation 
felt pretty nice, I think~...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
At El's house, we put tons of spices on 
our food, deeesu! Spicy food is the taste 
of home, desu ne~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If you keep eating spicy food too, 
Trainer, maybe you'll end up like us 
eventually?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
To think that Crown-san would step in 
between the two great powerhouses of super 
spicy food!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it seems we need to revise our 
rankings...! Crown-san is truly 
formidable...!

A debate broke out among some of the 
students over which of the three had the 
highest spice tolerance.
